ns2:course.label: Traditional Rendering Techniques
ns2:course.description: Lecture and studio course focused on the basic skills of creating hand renderings of scenographic ideas for theatrical stage productions using traditional materials, tools, and techniques. The course will be divided into two parts: 1) Introduction to traditional rendering materials and techniques, and 2) Creation of technically and materially accurate final renderings based on scaled drawings. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: THEA 125 is required for undergraduates.
